pipeline_run.tool_calls_note: The run's two MCP calls: the arguments each step sent and the value it received. Microsoft Learn's page excerpts (each result's content) are dropped; the pipeline reads only title and contentUrl. Replaying these through rote's prefix runner reproduces output.

fields.name: sections
fields.why: The skill fixes the digest's two sections; no server supplies them.

fields.name: reading_list_size
fields.why: The skill keeps the first 5 results, and Microsoft Learn returns 10 for this topic, so the list is 5 long whatever the index holds.

fields.name: reading_list
fields.why: Microsoft Learn search over a live index: which pages rank in the first five, their order, their titles and their URLs change as docs are published, retitled or moved.

fields.name: repo_outline
fields.why: DeepWiki regenerates a repo's wiki from the repo, so page names and numbering change when it re-indexes. Slower than the search results: the outline's first pages read the same on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-22.

drift.observed: Across five runs over 44 minutes, nothing drifted: every pipeline run got byte-identical tool results (all ten search results, excerpts included, and the wiki outline) and returned the same digest, and both agent runs returned that digest without its trailing newline. Against a run recorded on 2026-10-20 (tests/fixtures/mcp_results/docs_digest.json), the first two search results and the start of the outline were also unchanged.
drift.expected: Over days and weeks: the reading list (ranking, titles, URLs) first, the repo outline slowly. The section headings and the number of reading-list bullets are not live data.
drift.quirks: Microsoft Learn returns several chunks of one page as separate results, so the first five can repeat a URL (four of the five recorded links are the same page). The skill and the pipeline both keep the repeats, as the skill says to.
